f65f21.evidence: Dynamic PoC against the running service proved unauthenticated command execution with in-band output exfiltration for four payload classes (;, &&, backticks, $(...)) — `id` output and a unique marker returned in the response. Fix (execFile with argument array + `--` terminator) applied to server.js, service restarted, and all payload classes re-tested as blocked while benign behavior is preserved. Report vuln-0001 filed with the fix inline.
